{{Top|leg}}
'''Mekebve pollen''' caused a strong histamine reaction in [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and most [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], but not [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]].

Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk's]] plan to use Mekebve pollen to incapacitate and capture [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] by releasing it aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Bossk tested the potency of the spores by pumping a very small amount into the ventilation system of the [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] and exposed the Human, [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin]] and [[Chenlambec]], her Wookiee [[Ng'rhr]] to the pollen. Both suffered severe allergic reactions even under such limited exposure.
